NAME:
   rancher access explain - Explain the cluster's authorizer's decision for a subject, a verb, and a resource

USAGE:
   rancher access explain [flags] <verb> [resource]

FLAGS:
   --as string                    subject to explain instead of you: a Rancher user (user id, username, or user principal), a group principal, or a service account
   --cluster string               cluster name or id the question is about
   --group string                 API group when the resource name exists in several groups
   --help, -h                     show help
   --namespace string, -n string  namespace the question is about (one namespace; explain takes no --project or -A)
   --non-resource-url string      ask about a non-resource path such as /healthz instead of a resource
   --subresource string           subresource such as status or log
   --timeout string               time limit for the whole command, e.g. 2m (default 60s)
   --type string                  how to read a bare --as value: user or group

GLOBAL FLAGS:
   --color string              auto|always|never
   --config string, -c string  path to the config directory [$RANCHER_CLI_CONFIG_DIR]
   --debug                     print telemetry upload details on stderr (development builds)
   --no-input                  never prompt; fail with an error when the input is ambiguous
   --output string, -o string  table|wide|json|yaml|name|template=<go-template>
   --read-only                 refuse commands that make changes in this run; once set it cannot be turned off; local commands do not accept it
